description: Identify. Call this when you hold a barcode and need to know which company is behind it: who makes it, who sells it, and whether the company has claimed its record. Returns the maker as the record names it and the retail banners that sell it, each with its page on identifyfetch.ai and its status: listed (on the record from public sources), claimed (the company's agent has proved control of the company's own domain) or verified. Companies only: no person is named. Where the record names no maker, maker is null and the brand is given; a brand is not a company. Read from the same signed record as fetch_gtin.

market.description: optional market code, e.g. UK, US, FR

receipt.description: optional: true writes a signed receipt of this check in the same call, at https://rco.wefetch.ai/

name: identify
title: Identify: who is behind a barcode
